ttl.name: Fuel Suction Tube Assembly (w/ Pump & Gauge) (2GR-FE)

s-1.ptxt: Install Fuel Suction Tube Assembly w/ Fuel Pump

s2.ptxt: Connect the fuel tube and install the fuel suction tube assembly to the fuel tank.

atten3.ptxt: Do not bend the arm of the fuel sender gauge.

s2.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the fuel suction tube assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Fuel Tank Vent Tube Set Plate

s2.ptxt: Align the marks on the fuel tank vent tube set plate and fuel suction tube assembly, and tighten the fuel tank vent tube set plate and fuel tank protector NO.3 together with the 8 screws.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Fuel Emission Tube NO.1

s2.ptxt: Align the axes of the pipe and connector, and insert until a "click" sound is heard. (*1)
After connecting, pull on the connector and pipe to check that they are securely connected.

atten3.ptxt: Before the work, check that there are no scratches or foreign matter on the connecting parts of the pipe and connector.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Fuel Hose

s2.ptxt: Connect the fuel hose to the fuel suction tube assembly so that the hose paint mark (white) faces the top of the vehicle. (*2)

s-1.ptxt: Connect Charcoal Canister Outlet Hose NO.1

s2.ptxt: Connect the charcoal canister outlet hose No.1 to the fuel suction tube assembly so that the hose paint mark (white) faces the top of the vehicle. (*3)

s-1.ptxt: Connect Fuel Tank Main Tube

s2.ptxt: Insert the fuel tank main tube into the plug of the suction tube assembly.
Install the tube joint clip.

item.ptxt: Check that there are no scratches or foreign matter on the joint.
Check that the fuel tank main tube assembly is inserted securely all the way.
Check that the tube joint clip is on the collar of the fuel tank main tube.
After installing the tube joint clip, check that the fuel tank main tube assembly does not come out.
After connecting the fuel tank main tube, check that the fuel hose is below the fuel tank main tube.

s2.ptxt: Connect the fuel pump connector.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Battery Negative Terminal
Add Fuel
Fuel Leak Inspection
Install Rear Floor Service Hole Cover

s2.ptxt: Using new butyl tape, install the rear floor service hole cover.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 8 claws to install the rear door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Scuff Plate LH

atten4.ptxt: Install using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Outer Belt Assembly Center (RH Seat Position)

s2.ptxt: Install the rear seat outer belt assembly center, rear seat inner belt assembly and washer with the bolt.

item.ptxt: Pay attention to the installation direction of the floor anchor.
Be careful that the floor anchor does not ride up onto the locator.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Assembly RH (Seat Position RH Side)

s2.ptxt: Set the rear seat assembly RH in the vehicle, and install the 2 rear side bolts in the order inner → outer.
Raise the seatback, and install the 2 front side bolts of the rear seat assembly RH in the order inner → outer.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.2 (RH Seat Position)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws and install the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.1 (RH Seat Position)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws and install the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Headrest Assembly Center (RH Seat Position)
Install Rear Seat Headrest Assembly (RH Seat Position)
Install Rear Seat Assembly LH (Seat Position LH Side)

s2.ptxt: Set the rear seat assembly LH in the vehicle, and install the 2 rear side bolts in the order inner → outer.
Raise the seatback, and install the 2 front side bolts of the rear seat assembly LH in the order inner → outer.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.2 (LH Seat Position)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws to install the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.1 (LH Seat Position)

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws and install the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.1.
